title: AI now fronts shopping, so our store and feeds must be agent-ready
summary: 55% of consumers use AI in product discovery (NIQ); 34% of US shoppers would use GenAI for gift ideas (Gartner). Google launched Universal Cart in Search and Gemini; Amex built an AI-agent purchase framework; memory prices are rising.

points.headline: AI discovery is mainstream and Google now owns a cross-retailer cart
points.detail: NIQ: 55% use AI in discovery; Shopify says AI-driven discovery converts better; Google launched Universal Cart. We need AI-readable catalogs and feeds before holiday.

points.headline: Payment networks are building trust rails for agent checkout
points.detail: Amex introduced a framework so AI agents only buy what users authorize. We should be ready to accept authorized agent orders for PCs and accessories.

points.headline: Memory undersupply keeps PC costs rising while Apple and Microsoft fight at the low end
points.detail: DRAM and NAND prices rise into Q4 and Samsung locks 80% of 2027 output; Apple pressures Microsoft’s low-cost Surface. We should plan pricing and entry-level lineup.

points.headline: Holiday demand is growing and financing is a competitive lever
points.detail: Adobe forecasts record $275.1B US online holiday sales; Amazon added BNPL in the UK via Affirm. We should check Cyber 5 inventory and our instalment options.
